messages.subject: gl2structure for silicoDArT
parts:
Hi everyone,

Is there capability within dartR to convert a silicoDArT data set to STRUCTURE input format? I gather that gl2structure (and gl2faststructure) are applicable to SNP data only.

Many thanks,
Caroline.

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: RE: [dartR] gl2structure for silicoDArT
parts:
Hi Caroline,

 

I think we were too strict here and stopped the function to work with silicodart (as I did not test it).

 

From my limited example (see below) I think the export actually works with any ploidy (also with other then 1=silico or 2=SNP).

 

So I changed that in the function gl2structure.gs, but please check the resulting file for consistency (e.g. export only a small data set and check if the output is correct.).

 

The code changes an absence into 1 and a presence into 2 (and missing to -9) so from my perspective that should work.

 

tt <- testset.gs[166:170,50:60]

as.matrix(tt)

 

gl2structure2(tt, outpath = "d:/temp", outfile = "ss.str", ploidy=1)

 

 

output

> tt <- testset.gs[166:170,50:60]

> as.matrix(tt)

        6244920 19267659 4130652 6239937 19249010 6214399 6228441 4134467 4134999

AA18369       0        0       1       1        1       1      NA      NA       0

AA32880       0        0       0      NA        0       1       0      NA       1

AA19156       0        0       0      NA        0       1       0       1       0

AA20371       0        0       0       1        0       1      NA       1       0

UC_1051       0        0       0       1        0       1       1       0       1

        4135235 20127086

AA18369       0        0

AA32880       0        0

AA19156       0        0

AA20371       0        0

UC_1051       0        0

> gl2structure2(tt, outpath = "d:/temp", outfile = "ss.str", ploidy=1)

Starting gl2structure2

Detected Presence/Absence (SilicoDArT) data. Please provide a SNP dataset

Structure file saved as: d:/temp/ss.strCompleted: gl2structure2

NULL

>

 

ss.str file:

 

6244920                19267659             4130652                6239937                19249010             6214399                6228441                4134467                4134999                4135235                20127086

AA18369              1              1              2              2              2              2              -9            -9            1              1              1

AA32880              1              1              1              -9            1              2              1              -9            2              1              1

AA19156              1              1              1              -9            1              2              1              2              1              1              1

AA20371              1              1              1              2              1              2              -9            2              1              1              1

UC_1051              1              1              1              2              1              2              2              1              2              1              1

 

 

 

The changed function is here (gl2structure.gs): (copy paste from here on)

 

 

 

 

gl2structure.gs <-

function (x, indNames = NULL, addcolumns = NULL, ploidy = 1,

          exportMarkerNames = TRUE, outfile = "gl.str", outpath = tempdir(),

          verbose = NULL)

{

  funname <- match.call()[[1]]

  build <- "Jacob"

  outfilespec <- file.path(outpath, outfile)

  if (is.null(verbose)) {

    if (!is.null(x@other$verbose)) {

      verbose <- x@other$verbose

    }

    else {

      verbose <- 2

    }

  }

  if (verbose < 0 | verbose > 5) {

    cat(paste("  Warning: Parameter 'verbose' must be an integer between 0 [silent] and 5 [full report], set to 2\n"))

    verbose <- 2

  }

  if (verbose >= 1) {

    if (verbose == 5) {

      cat("Starting", funname, "[ Build =",

          build, "]\n")

    }

    else {

      cat("Starting", funname, "\n")

    }

  }

  if (class(x) != "genlight") {

    stop("  Fatal Error: genlight object required!\n")

  }

  if (verbose >= 2) {

    if (all(x@ploidy == 1)) {

      cat("Detected Presence/Absence (SilicoDArT) data. Please provide a SNP dataset\n")

    }

    else if (all(x@ploidy == 2)) {

      cat("  Processing a SNP dataset\n")

    }

    else {

      stop("Fatal Error: Ploidy must be universally 1 (fragment P/A data) or 2 (SNP data)")

    }

  }

  nInd <- nInd(x)

  if (is.null(indNames)) {

    indNames = indNames(x)

  }

  if (length(indNames) != nInd) {

    stop("Fatal Error: No. of individuals listed in user-specified indNames and no. of individuals in supplied genlight object x do not match\n")

  }

  if (!is.null(addcolumns) && is.null(dim(addcolumns)))

    addcolumns <- data.frame(pop = addcolumns)

  if (!is.null(addcolumns) && nrow(addcolumns) != nInd) {

    stop("Fatal Error: No. of individuals in user-specified addColumns and no. of individuals in supplied genlight object x does not match\n")

  }

  genmat <- as.matrix(x)

  if (!all(genmat %in% c(0:ploidy, NA))) {

    stop("Fatal Error: genmat must only contain 0, 1, 2... ploidy and NA\n")

  }

  if (length(outfile) != 1 || !is.character(outfile)) {

    stop("Fatal Error: output file must be a single character string\n")

  }

  if (length(ploidy) != 1 || !is.numeric(ploidy)) {

    stop("Fatal Error: ploidy must be a single number\n")

  }

  if (!exportMarkerNames %in% c(TRUE, FALSE)) {

    stop("Fatal Error: exportMarkerNames must be TRUE or FALSE\n")

  }

  G <- list()

  for (i in 0:ploidy) {

    G[[i + 1]] <- c(rep(1, ploidy - i), rep(2, i))

  }

  G[[ploidy + 2]] <- rep(-9, ploidy)

  StructTab <- data.frame(ind = rep(indNames, each = ploidy))

  if (!is.null(addcolumns)) {

    for (i in 1:dim(addcolumns)[2]) {

      StructTab <- data.frame(StructTab, rep(addcolumns[,

                                                        i], each = ploidy))

      if (!is.null(dimnames(addcolumns)[[2]])) {

        names(StructTab)[i + 1] <- dimnames(addcolumns)[[2]][i]

      }

      else {

        names(StructTab)[i + 1] <- paste("X", i,

                                         sep = "")

      }

    }

  }

  for (i in 1:dim(genmat)[2]) {

    thesegen <- genmat[, i] + 1

    thesegen[is.na(thesegen)] <- ploidy + 2

    StructTab[[dimnames(genmat)[[2]][i]]] <- unlist(G[thesegen])

  }

  if (exportMarkerNames) {

    cat(paste(locNames(x), collapse = "\t"), sep = "\n",

        file = outfilespec)

  }

  write.table(StructTab, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE,

              append = TRUE, sep = "\t", file = outfilespec,

              quote = FALSE)

  if (verbose >= 2)

    cat(paste("Structure file saved as:", outfilespec))

  if (verbose > 0) {

    cat("Completed:", funname, "\n")

  }

  return(NULL)

}

Hi Bernd,

Brilliant, thank you for your solution with gl2structure. I am trying to test it with subsets of the test data and my own data and will report back if any inconsistencies in the conversions.

I think however I am stuck on the basic implementation of the function gl2structure.gs from the global environment.
Defining the function gl2structure.gs and running

is fine. But then running
gl2structure.gs(tt, outpath = "~/dartR/R/analysis/Typh2020/structure", outfile = "test.str", ploidy=1)
doesn't return " Starting gl2structure2 " or any output data that I can find.

What am I probably doing incorrectly? Also, I took "gl2structure2" from your above to be equivalent to "gl2structure.gs" and used the latter,  but I may be missing something. 

Greatly appreciative of your help,
Regards
Caroline.
